title: Nonlinear Schrödinger equation in an exterior domain
summary: We study the exact controllability of the cubic nonlinear Schrödinger equation in the exterior $Ω=\mathbb{R}^n\setminusΘ$ of a non-trapping obstacle $Θ$, with internal controls supported outside a large ball, and the corresponding boundary control problem on $Ω_0=B_{R_0}\setminusΘ$ with Dirichlet controls acting only on the outer sphere $\partial B_{R_0}$.
